calls.reason: This is a hyperbolic forecast with no deadline. No always-on OpenAI device had shipped by October 2026, and no study in the packet tests persuasion by an LLM holding a full record of a user's speech.

OpenAI's May 21, 2025 announcement says io's hardware and manufacturing team would merge into OpenAI. That is a substantial move into hardware, even though MacRumors notes the deal was still awaiting approval.

No io device had been released, so its capture and data-use practices are unknown. Tang Tan's court filing says the first device is not a wearable, and July 2026 reports describe a home speaker, so the claim's assumed design is unmet.

The specific article is unidentified. Still, a peer-reviewed GPT-4 debate study from May 19, 2025 found GPT-4 measurably out-persuaded humans, supporting the main claim. The 2026 correction weakens only the hedged point about personal data.
